scenes.headline: How a speech-only model takes turns
scenes.sub: Block's Dessa, and what its two-track demos show
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Davit! Block says Dessa learned to talk from audio alone. Here's how a model like that takes turns.

scenes.text: A full-duplex model reads your audio and writes its own on one clock, so taking turns is just predicting the next frame.
scenes.say: The idea: listen and speak on one clock. Every tick, read a frame of you, write a frame of itself.

scenes.title: Two ways to build a voice

left.title: A cascade
items: A text model answers, a voice reads it
left.say: A cascade waits for you to stop, transcribes, and reads an answer back. The laugh never reaches the model.

right.title: Full-duplex
right.say: A full-duplex model never stops listening, so a quick yeah while you talk is just a likely next frame.

steps.say: A codec turns each slice of your audio into a few tokens.
Your tokens and the model's own sit side by side.
A transformer trained on recorded calls reads it all.
It writes its next frame, speech or silence, and feeds it back. Listening is predicting silence.

scenes.title: What Block says it left out
scenes.say: Moshi, the open reference design, leans on a text model. Block says Dessa drops it.

items.say: No pretrained model. Trained from scratch on conversation.
One rack of GPUs. No paper or weights yet.

scenes.title: Each speaker on its own track

steps.say: Block did publish demo calls, each speaker on its own track.
So you can time exactly who talks when.

scenes.label: Dessa's median gap before it takes the floor
scenes.note: the people in the same calls: +0.39 s
scenes.say: Dessa's median gap before it starts talking is about a quarter of a second. Its human partners wait a little longer.

scenes.title: Turns that start in overlap
scenes.say: And it starts in overlap slightly more often than they do.

scenes.text: Timing can be learned from audio alone. Facts, failure rates and a fair test are still unpublished.
scenes.say: Timing can be learned from sound alone. Facts, failure rates and a fair test are still missing.

recap: One clock, two streams, no turns
No text and no pretrained model
Human-like timing in Block's own demos
scenes.say: One clock, two streams, no text, and human timing in the demos Block chose.
